editor.places a rectangular block of material o: places a rectangular block of material on the ground
editor.places a ramp rising along Z to the chos: places a ramp rising along Z to the chosen height
editor.creates a flat pad at the clicked height: creates a flat pad at the clicked height, blending into the surrounding terrain
editor.creates a circular pond, initially 1 met: creates a circular pond, initially 1 metre above the clicked ground
editor.adds a grayscale heightmap to the bedroc: adds a grayscale heightmap to the bedrock; black and white map to the low and high settings
editor.deposits material from an image mask, wi: deposits material from an image mask, with material and thickness set per pixel value
editor.paints vegetation over a rectangle, usin: paints vegetation over a rectangle, using one type or an image mask
editor.creates scattered domes or narrow towers: creates scattered domes or narrow towers of material within a rectangle
editor.scatters trees in a circle, limited by s: scatters trees in a circle, limited by slope and a mask
editor.thins listed trees inside an outline, le: thins listed trees inside an outline, leaving stumps and heath
editor.carves a hollow below the clicked ground: carves a hollow below the clicked ground
editor.adds material under the brush; uses the: adds material under the brush; uses the existing surface material unless you choose a fill
editor.raises the ground, including its layers,: raises the ground, including its layers, grass and water, without adding material
